Academic project

CPU Library - Collection Search2025
  • A functional prototype of a search bar widget that enables users to input any inquiries and retrieve the relevant results directly from the Follet Destiny Discover of CPU Henry Luce III Library.
  • Using HTML, PHP, and JavaScript that I learned from Programming Fundamentals, I created a search bar widget for CPU Henry Luce III Library collections.
  • This project provides a more direct and intuitive way to access the collection.

Webinar & workshop

Librarian in Formation: Training-Workshop for BLIS Students2026
  • This seminar was a two-day event hosted by the Philippine Library Group of Law Librarians. On the first day, we were introduced to key developments in digital libraries, artificial intelligence (AI), and library management. On the second day, we had a hands-on learning experience focused on conservation, archival handling, and bookbinding.
Ctrl + Alt + Learn: Information Literacy for the Digital Navigators of Today2026
  • This webinar was facilitated by our block during the previous academic year. I was one of the members of the program committee who helped organize and create a successful and engaging seminar as part of the requirements for our Seminar in Librarianship course.
